decision: Why isn't this page converting, and which fixes should we make first?
limitations: It scores the pass, partial or fail judgements made against the rubric. It doesn't read the page or see real visitor behaviour, so the score is only as good as those judgements.
Unknown check names and values other than pass, partial or fail stop the run. A check you omit counts as fail and is listed as "Not assessed"; read that line.
Category weights and grade bands are fixed. The skill says to judge against the page's one goal, but the engine weighs a pricing page and a blog post the same way.
The fix list follows rubric order, not measured impact. The expected effect of each fix is a judgement, not a forecast.
review: Whoever owns the page confirms each check against the live page on desktop and mobile and against its one conversion goal, and confirms conversion tracking works before any fix is credited with a lift.
